patch.value: Latest published manifest fails pm 2026.8.20 strict health

pm-csv 2026.8.16 still ships the legacy pm.compatibility object. The current host reports extension_manifest_unknown_key:project:pm-csv:key=pm and pm health --strict-exit fails even after installing the latest npm artifact. Remove only the inert legacy key after a complete-raw-manifest SDK regression test proves zero findings, update the development CLI/SDK to 2026.8.20, and validate a packed artifact in a fresh real host.

A regression test passes the complete raw manifest to the current public SDK and requires compatible true with zero findings; The manifest contains only current SDK-supported keys and keeps the enforced pm_min_version floor; A packed artifact installs and activates warning-free under pm 2026.8.20 in a fresh project; Release, coverage, docstring, duplication, vulnerability, PM, and privacy gates pass without lowering thresholds
pm CLI 2026.8.20 with npm pm-csv 2026.8.16 installed in project scope
Install npm:pm-csv@2026.8.16 into a pm 2026.8.20 project and run pm health --strict-exit
The latest package activates with no manifest contract findings and strict health stays green.
The host reports extension_manifest_unknown_key for key pm and strict health exits non-zero.
